name: Helior Bronze Summit
loreTies: Laurel Supremacy: excellence chains bonuses after clean tactical execution.
Helior Bronze Summit is a colossal Olympian deity shaped by excellence proves divinity. It manifests the Realm's law through battlefield-scale mythic force.
shortBackstory: Helior Bronze Summit is an Olympian Artillery whose Gate scar links The Celestial Heights of Olympus to Storm-Oath Covenant; their power expresses excellence proves divinity under campaign pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Helior Bronze Summit began as more than a weapon in The Celestial Heights of Olympus. Helior Bronze Summit was bound to a trial terrace in the Celestial Heights during a Gate disturbance that tested whether excellence proves divinity could survive contact with the Hollow. The title carried in their name was earned when the Deity chose duty over spectacle and accepted a burden ordinary soldiers could not survive.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Olympian, Helior Bronze Summit is treated as proof that a civilization of glory, perfection, contest, beauty, achievement, and divine supremacy can become battlefield doctrine without losing its soul. Their silhouette carries bronze, gold, marble, celestial light, living statue anatomy, ichor-lit cracks, sculptural bodies, but their real identity is tactical: elite balanced pressure, precision, dueling, morale momentum. Every deployment makes faction philosophy visible through movement, restraint, and force.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Gate did not simply attack Helior Bronze Summit; it tried to measure what their Realm values most. The wound echoed sacred doctrine back as bait, tempting the Deity to overextend, break battle pattern, or turn culture into raw fuel. Helior Bronze Summit survived by refusing the Gate's terms, leaving a scar that still reacts whenever excellence trials appears on the map.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Storm-Oath Covenant, Helior Bronze Summit gives the campaign a personal lens on faction survival. Their presence reinforces the rule that faction identity stays distinct unless a mission explicitly permits otherwise. In a one-active-deity active deity, Helior Bronze Summit turns Laurel Supremacy from a passive rule into a story statement: the Realm is defending its meaning.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Helior Bronze Summit's flaw is overcommitment to the belief that their Realm's answer must always be enough. NPC witnesses and rival factions challenge that certainty as the Hollow learns to imitate law, oath, balance, life, radiance, and ambition without understanding any of them. Their battlefield stats support this arc: HP 34, attack 6, range 2, speed 3, energy 3.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
